# Join the discussion

Beyond the statistics of the survey lies a rich landscape of personal insights, arguments, and reflections. This is a public forum to share your standpoint on artificial intelligence, consciousness, and the future we are building.

We invite you to contribute your thoughts. Your post will be publicly visible to all visitors of this site, creating a shared space for diverse perspectives.

A few guidelines for your post:

- The editor supports basic **Markdown** for formatting (e.g., `**bold**`, `*italics*`, lists).
- Please aim to keep your contribution concise, up to roughly one page of text.
- We encourage respectful and constructive dialogue. Submissions will be moderated to maintain a welcoming environment.

Your voice adds a vital qualitative dimension to this exploration. What do you think?

```{=html}
<form id="discussion-post">
  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="post-author">Your Name (as it will appear publicly):</label>
    <input type="text" id="post-author" name="author" required maxlength="80">
  </div>

  <div class="form-group" style="margin-top: 1.5rem;">
    <label for="post-content">Your Post:</label>
    <textarea id="post-content" name="content"></textarea>
  </div>
  
  <button type="submit">Submit post</button>
</form>

<div id="form-messages" role="status" aria-live="polite" style="margin-top: 1em;"></div>
```
